entries.title: Psalms 76:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a song.>> In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 76:2
segments: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his  dwelling-place in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 76:3
segments: There he brake the  arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 76:4
segments: Glorious art thou [and] excellent,  From the mountains of prey.

entries.title: Psalms 76:5
segments: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

entries.title: Psalms 76:6
segments: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 76:7
segments: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

entries.title: Psalms 76:8
segments: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,

entries.title: Psalms 76:9
segments: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 76:10
segments: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou  gird upon thee.

entries.title: Psalms 76:11
segments: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 76:12
segments: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
